backlog.notes: Repo audit complete. Backend has Phases 1-4 partially implemented on SQLite: schedule/progress ingestion, Time-Agent chat, hybrid matching engine, confidence scoring, planner review queue, audit trail, XER import/export with predecessor/successor. Missing: PostgreSQL, Redis/Celery, JWT/RBAC, Alembic, frontend, design system, synthetic data generator, SQLite backup mechanism. Python 3.9 incompatible union syntax in matching/service.py and extraction_service.py. No docker-compose.yml. P5 XER round-trip partially implemented but needs verification against full spec (.mpp support, write-back on approval, export).

PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector configured via docker-compose.yml. Alembic initial migration (d688256165ff) created with all PRD §9 tables: organizations, users, projects, ingestion_sources, wbs_nodes (with vector(1536)), event_wbs_matches, glossary_mappings, delay_reasons, productivity_benchmarks, audit_logs, plus existing Phase 1-4 tables. Migration runs clean on fresh SQLite and PostgreSQL. Database.py supports both SQLite (dev) and PostgreSQL (prod) with async/sync engines.

Redis and Celery configured in docker-compose.yml. Celery app in app/core/celery_app.py with worker, beat, and backup task (app/workers/backup.py). Redis used as broker and result backend. Beat schedule includes hourly SQLite backup task.

JWT auth with access/refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, CSRF double-submit token, role-based access control (5 roles: SYSTEM_ADMIN, CONTRACTOR_ADMIN, PROJECT_CONTROLS, DISCIPLINE_PLANNER, SITE_SUPERVISOR). Auth endpoints: /auth/login, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, /auth/me, /auth/users, /auth/csrf-token. CORS configured with strict allowlist. Organization/project scoping enforced via dependencies. Audit logging on auth events. Seed script creates demo org, project, and 5 users across all roles.

SQLite backup mechanism implemented as Celery Beat task (app/workers/backup.py). Dumps core tables to backups/consight_backup_<timestamp>.db with retention policy (keep last 24). Restore procedure documented in code.

XER import/export with predecessor/successor relationships exists in backend/app/services/xer/. parser.py uses xerparser, export.py writes XER. schedule_relationships table stores FS/SS/FF/SF + lag. Missing: .mpp support (mpxj/aspose-tasks), write-back of actuals on planner approval (/api/v1/schedule/matches/{match_id}/resolve), export of current actuals back to XER/MSP format. Need to verify against PRD §8.2 and add-on Phase 5 spec.
